text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Yes, PARTY_1 has the right to audit Inktomi's books and records for purposes of auditing and verifying costs and expenses, provided that PARTY_1 shall give Inktomi reasonable notice prior to each requested audit (C2).","citations":[{"chunk_id":"C2","quote":"Inktomi shall permit PARTY_1 to have access to, and to make copies of, all such books and records for purposes of auditing and verifying such costs and expenses,"}]}
